At December 31, 2016, certain foreign subsidiaries of the Company had net operating loss carryforwards of
approximately $26.3. Approximately $1.0 of such net operating loss carryforwards expire on various dates
through December 31, 2021. The remaining net operating loss carryforwards are not subject to expiration.

The Company believes that it is more likely than not that the benefit from these net operating loss
carryforwards will not be realized. In recognition of this risk, the Company has provided a valuation allowance of
$8.0 and $6.2 at December 31, 2016 and 2015, respectively, on the deferred tax asset relating to these net
operating loss carryforwards.
